description: Baseline assessment and the held-out weekly challenge bank. Weekly prompts are never used elsewhere in the app, so a weekly take measures retained skill on an unseen prompt.

baseline.title: An interview answer
baseline.prompt: Tell me about a time you had to learn something new quickly. What did you do?

baseline.title: An explanation
baseline.prompt: Explain something you know well to someone who has never heard of it.

baseline.title: An impromptu talk
baseline.prompt: What is a small change that made your work or life noticeably better?

weekly.prompt: Tell me about a decision you made with incomplete data. How did it turn out?
Describe a time you received critical feedback. What did you change?
Tell me about a time you had to influence someone without authority.
Describe the most complex system you've worked on and your role in it.
Explain to your team why you're changing the sprint process starting next week.
Ask leadership for two more weeks on a project, and explain why it's worth it.
Announce that a popular tool is being retired and what replaces it.
Explain how a search engine decides which results to show first.
Explain what a database index is and when it doesn't help.
Explain how two-factor authentication protects an account.
Explain the difference between a process and a thread to a designer.
What is the best advice you've ignored, and why?
Describe a place that changed how you think.
Is it better to be early or to be exactly on time?
What would you teach a room full of ten-year-olds in five minutes?
A customer asks why your integration needs three weeks when a competitor promises one. Respond.
A customer's pilot succeeded but their CFO is hesitant to expand. Make the case.
A customer reports data looks wrong in your dashboard. Open the conversation.
Explain to a customer why you recommend against the custom feature they asked for.
What is something you believe about building software that many people disagree with?
